note: Pre-registered test of Ashraf's 'Crypto Futures Setup Validator' prompt (19 Nov), turned into exact rules. Binance USDT-M futures 5-min candles, resampled to 15m / 1h / 4h; every feature uses closed candles only (merged on close time). Swings = 1h pivots with 3 candles each side (confirmed 3 hours later); BTC 4h swings = 2 candles each side. Patterns that need the eye (double top/bottom, head & shoulders) are NOT tested — only LL/HL + BOS. One trade per BOS, one open trade per coin, entry on the next 5-min open, 48 h max. Change a variant = new id.

rules_text.layer1_btc: STRONG BEARISH = BTC 4h close < EMA50 4h and last 4h swing high < previous and last swing low < previous -> no LONG. STRONG BULLISH = mirror -> no SHORT. LONG also needs BTC 1h close > EMA50 1h and last 1h swing low > previous.
rules_text.layer1_ema50: reject LONG if pair price < EMA50(4h) x 0.95; reject SHORT if > EMA50(4h) x 1.05
rules_text.layer1_24h: reject LONG if 24h change < -15%; reject SHORT if > +15%
rules_text.layer1_candle: LONG: last closed 5m candle green and last closed 15m not red. SHORT: mirror.
rules_text.layer3: LONG: bullish BOS (1h close above the last confirmed swing high) with last swing low > previous (HL). SHORT: bearish BOS below the last swing low with last swing high < previous (LH). BOS must be at most 3 hours old.
rules_text.layer2: BOS +8 (always, required) · CHoCH +3 (the BOS direction differs from the previous BOS) · FVG +7 (an unfilled 15m fair-value gap of the trade side from the last 6 h, price inside it or within 1% of it) · volume +5 (BOS candle volume >= 1.5x the 20-hour average)

exits.prompt: as written: SL 2% judged on a 5m close (exit at that close), no hard stop; at +2% price (+10% at 5x) SL to entry (also on close); auto-close at +3% price (+15% at 5x) — so the 4% target is never reached
exits.fixed: corrected: SL 2% on a 5m close + hard stop 3%; TP1 +2% close half and SL to entry; TP2 +4% the rest
exits.plain: plain 1:2: hard SL 2%, TP 4%, both intrabar
